column1: # EXP-R2-225 all-or-stop interface qualification of Qwen2.5-7B, one arm, one cell.
# This is the prerequisite, not the measurement. The campaign's deliverable amendment
# routes the pure-text wave through 01_cohort_power.py and then stage 41, and
# second_stage_interface_qualification.py is the fixed-sequence gate that stands in
# front of it: "Failure of any clause stops that arm ... no other arm is moved into
# the vacant slot". So stage 01 for this rung is a SEPARATE dispatch taken only after
# this cell returns PASS. A slot barrier orders cells but does not make one
# conditional on another's verdict, and an all-or-stop gate needs conditionality
# The unit is the arm, which is that stage's own declaration and the reason each
# checkpoint is one cell writing one artefact named for it. Only Qwen2.5-7B is here:
# Qwen2.5-32B's 62 GB were still staging when this was written, and the freeze's
# operational sequence verifies the smaller rung first in any case.
# --dtype bfloat16 is the stage's own default and this campaign's precision; it is
# written out so the manifest states the precision the gate was passed at, since a
# pass at one precision is not a pass at another.
